messages:
evan_acme: Hi team — SOC2 auditor asked for evidence that two CVEs affecting our runtime have been patched in our tenant (CVE-2025-3344, CVE-2025-7781). Can you confirm patch timeline and whether key rotation / KMS impact will be needed? Also need an SBOM export and a short triage note for the report. Deadline EOD Fri.

alex: Thanks Evan. We're starting triage. Quick question — are you on Hosted, Dedicated, or Private? That changes the remediation/playbook.

evan_acme: Private (VPC, customer-managed KMS).

marie: Copy. For Private we coordinate a maintenance window. Short note: most fixes are library updates, unlikely to require re-encryption, but we'll provide a formal KMS impact statement. We can export SBOM (CycloneDX) + a signed PDF attestation.

samir: Triage summary: CVE-2025-3344 (libhttp2) — CVSS 7.1, affects http stack in runtime image; upstream fix available in libhttp2 v1.4.2. CVE-2025-7781 (tokenizer dep) — CVSS 8.6, requires service restart; no public exploit seen in our infra. Treating 7781 as high for customer compliance. Owners: samir + marie.

alex: Proposed schedule: canary patch on internal dedicated cluster tomorrow 02:00 UTC, run smoke + canary log capture, then Private rollout Thu 20:00 UTC (customer window) assuming canary good. Evidence pack (SBOM + triage notes + canary logs) by Fri 09:00 UTC. If you need earlier, tell us.

evan_acme: KMS question: will key rotation be required? Our compliance team wants to know if patch touches encrypted artifacts or requires re-encrypting caches.

marie: Short answer: no forced rotation. These are code/library updates that do not change encryption format or keys. We'll include an explicit KMS impact statement: "No key rotation performed; key versions unchanged; no re-encryption of persistent data." If you insist on rotation for your audit, we can schedule one during the maintenance window — expect ~15m extra for cache rebuilds.

samir: Also note a minor RBAC change: new runtime control endpoint will require runtime.patch.apply permission for operators. We'll include the RBAC diff and an audit log sample showing the permission granted in staging.

sec-bot: incident-tracker: Created IR-2026-045 (customer-driven), severity: high, owners: samir, marie, alex.

tia: I can produce the SBOM export and the PDF attestation. Evan, which format does your auditor want for logs? PDF + CycloneDX SBOM + signed digest (sha256) ok?

evan_acme: Yes — PDF attestation + CycloneDX SBOM + canary logs signed. Also need a short written statement on KMS and RBAC changes.

alex: Plan of action (summary):
1) Canary: tomorrow 02:00 UTC on dedicated/test cluster. Capture logs + health checks.
2) Rollout: Thu 20:00 UTC in your Private tenant. Maintenance window 30m (15m if no rotation).
3) Deliverable: evidence pack (SBOM CycloneDX, signed PDF attestation, canary logs, RBAC diff + audit snippet, KMS impact statement) by Fri 09:00 UTC.

marie: We'll also add a playbook excerpt to the evidence so auditors can see exactly the steps we ran. Example snippet: 
```bash
# patch playbook excerpt
kubectl drain node-1 --ignore-daemonsets
kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=r-inference:v1.13.4
kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -w
# run health checks
curl -f https://localhost:8080/health || exit 1
# collect last 500 lines of audit logs
gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container" --limit 500 > /tmp/audit-snippet.log
```

samir: KMS sample output we'll include (anonymized):
```bash
gcloud kms keys versions list --key=projects/myproj/locations/us/keyRings/redwood/cryptoKeys/tenant-key --limit=10
# shows active key version 3 and no new versions created during patch
```

evan_acme: Please include the image digests and sha256 attestation for the patched image. Also include a short sign-off from your oncall after rollout.

alex: Will do — we'll attach image digests, canary logs with signed hash, and a one-line oncall sign-off.

evan_acme: Thanks all — ping me if anything blocks. 🙏

marie: Adding one more note: we'll flag this change in the private deployment's audit log retention policy — preserving related logs for 90 days as an evidence window. That will be reflected in the evidence pack.

samir: Updating IR-2026-045 with ETA and artifacts list now. If canary fails we'll roll back and notify; otherwise proceed as planned.
